List

Lists present related information in a vertical stack. Items flex between leading visuals, primary text and trailing content.

Basic List

Use .zak-list with .zak-list-item children.

  • Getting started guide
  • Components overview
  • Design tokens
  • Browser support
HTML
<ul class="zak-list">
  <li class="zak-list-item">Getting started guide</li>
  <li class="zak-list-item">Components overview</li>
  <li class="zak-list-item">Design tokens</li>
  <li class="zak-list-item">Browser support</li>
</ul>

List with Icons

Insert a leading icon on each item.

  • janet@example.com
    Primary
  • +1 555 010 2030
  • work@example.com
HTML
<ul class="zak-list">
  <li class="zak-list-item">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm zak-text-primary">...</svg>
    <span>janet@example.com</span>
  </li>
  <li class="zak-list-item">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm zak-text-success">...</svg>
    <span>+1 555 010 2030</span>
  </li>
</ul>

List with Avatars

Pair list items with avatars to build member and contact lists.

  • JA
    Janet Fox
    Product Designer
  • MK
    Mark Kim
    Frontend Engineer
  • SR
    Sara Reyes
    Data Analyst
HTML
<ul class="zak-list">
  <li class="zak-list-item">
    <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-sm zak-avatar-primary">JA</span>
    <div>
      <div style="font-weight: var(--zak-font-weight-medium);">Janet Fox</div>
      <div style="font-size: var(--zak-font-size-xs); color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Product Designer</div>
    </div>
  </li>
</ul>

List with Badges

Trailing badges are useful for counts and status.

  • Inbox 12
  • Drafts 3
  • Spam 7
HTML
<ul class="zak-list">
  <li class="zak-list-item">
    <span>Inbox</span>
    <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-primary" style="margin-left: auto;">12</span>
  </li>
</ul>

List with Actions

Append action buttons on the trailing edge of each item.

  • Quarterly review notes
  • Design tokens RFC
HTML
<li class="zak-list-item">
  <span style="flex: 1;">Quarterly review notes</span>
  <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft zak-btn-sm">Edit</button>
  <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft zak-btn-sm">Delete</button>
</li>

List with Dividers

Items are divided by a bottom border by default. Remove it with an explicit style override.

  • Divided item
  • Divided item
  • Divided item
  • Undivided item
  • Undivided item
  • Undivided item
HTML
<!-- With dividers (default) -->
<ul class="zak-list">
  <li class="zak-list-item">Divided item</li>
</ul>

<!-- Without dividers -->
<ul class="zak-list">
  <li class="zak-list-item" style="border-bottom: 0;">Undivided item</li>
</ul>

Ordered List

Plain ordered lists can use the list-style utilities such as .zak-list-decimal.

  1. Configure your build pipeline
  2. Install the package via npm
  3. Import the compiled stylesheet
  4. Start using components
HTML
<ol class="zak-list-decimal">
  <li>Configure your build pipeline</li>
  <li>Install the package via npm</li>
  <li>Import the compiled stylesheet</li>
</ol>

Flush List

Remove the container border and rounding to create a flush list that can sit inside a card.

  • Account settings
  • Team members
  • Billing plan
  • Notifications
HTML
<div class="zak-card" style="overflow: hidden;">
  <ul class="zak-list" style="border: 0; border-radius: 0;">
    <li class="zak-list-item">Account settings</li>
    <li class="zak-list-item">Team members</li>
  </ul>
</div>

Numbered List

Use .zak-list-inside to position the numbers inside the content box for a tighter layout.

  1. Create a new post
  2. Add an engaging cover image
  3. Publish to your audience
  4. Analyze the engagement metrics
HTML
<ol class="zak-list-decimal zak-list-inside">
  <li>Create a new post</li>
  <li>Add an engaging cover image</li>
  <li>Publish to your audience</li>
</ol>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-listBase list container with surface, border and rounding
.zak-list-itemFlex row item with spacing and dividers
.zak-list-item-activeActive/selected item highlight
.zak-list-item-disabledMuted, non-interactive item
.zak-list-discDisc bullets for plain lists
.zak-list-circleCircle bullets
.zak-list-squareSquare bullets
.zak-list-decimalDecimal numbers for ordered lists
.zak-list-noneRemoves list markers
.zak-list-insidePositions markers inside the content box

Accessibility

  • Use semantic list elements <ul> / <ol> / <li> so screen readers announce structure.
  • Interactive items (links, buttons) must not be nested inside each other and need visible focus states.
  • Keep action buttons at least 24×24px to be comfortably tappable.
  • Where order matters, use an ordered list; otherwise use an unordered list.
